title: Town of Bethel Launches 24/7 AI Assistant on Town Hall's Main Line
summary: Residents of Bethel, Connecticut can now call Town Hall at any hour, get answers about Town services, report a pothole or a blocked catch basin, and reach the right office, with staff in control of every answer.
